name: Open-source SDKs
tagline: Yandex Maps, emoji and MyID eKYC for React Native & Expo

scenes.title: Yandex Maps, native in Expo
scenes.body: Markers, clustering, search, routing and offline maps on iOS and Android, set up by one config plugin.

scenes.title: Emoji 17 keyboard for chats
scenes.body: A FlashList v2 grid with search, skin tones and smart recents at keyboard height.

scenes.title: Reactions, then the full keyboard
scenes.body: A recent-first ReactionStrip opens the full keyboard in a bottom sheet; one package for iOS, Android and web.

scenes.title: MyID eKYC in one typed call
scenes.body: Unofficial wrapper: an Expo config plugin and a typed identify() around MyID's native face-liveness SDKs.
